text:
alex: Heads-up — after the runtime 2.4.1 canary rollout we're seeing p99 ~2x for text-gen endpoints in us-west1. Canary is 20% traffic. Spikes line up with kernel-selector=v3 enable. Anyone oncall? :rotating_light:
priya: link to grafana? which routes/models are noisy?
alex: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/p99-latency?var=env=prod&var=region=us-west1 — affected: /v1/generate (redwood-alpha), /v1/chat (redwood-chat). p95 also up but p99 is the loudest. attaching short log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate queue_ms=1204 exec_ms=60 kernel=selector-v3 node=runtime-gpu-12
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z request_id=def456 route=/v1/chat queue_ms=980 exec_ms=40 kernel=selector-v3 node=runtime-gpu-15
```
jamal: I can jump on this. kernel-selector v3 changed our scheduling heuristics for batching; might be causing head-of-line blocking for short requests behind long-context jobs.
tina: FYI support — two paying customers (Acme AI, Nexa Labs) opened high-priority tickets about p95 increases starting 10:10am PST. No billing/errors.
devex: can we route canary traffic to the old kernel quickly? also repro for support: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate -d '{"input":"lorem ipsum"}'`
ben (eng-sre): proposed triage:
  1) toggle kernel-selector OFF for canary 
  2) measure 15 min
  3) if p99 drops, keep toggle and patch selector
  4) else rollback runtime canary
suggested load repro: `hey -n 1000 -c 40 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @payload.json https://.../v1/generate` capture queue_ms.
maya: i'm oncall — toggling flag now, holding autoscaler changes.
ops-bot: deploy-flag: kernel_selector_v3 -> OFF for runtime-canary-2.4.1 at 2026-03-17T10:23:12Z
alex: quick local run after flip:
```
hey -n 300 -c 20 -m POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"short"}' https://canary.api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate
baseline p95 ~250ms
canary after flip p95 ~260ms (good)
canary before flip p95 ~980ms
queue_ms median dropped ~700ms -> ~50ms
```
jamal: sounds like selector scheduling mis-prioritizes short jobs. opening urgent PR to adjust batch eligibility & short-job preemption. will add perf tests.
ben: keep canary flag OFF, ramp canary to 0, set alert p95 > 350ms notify @eng-runtime.
priya: support updated customers and offered route to stable region/variant; customers accepted.
ops-bot: canary toggles persisted. canary traffic normalized at 10:36Z. monitoring watch enabled.
alex: follow-ups/tasks:
- ENG-Runtime: fix selector scheduling (jamal) — P0
- ENG-SRE: add canary p95 auto-snooze + pager (ben)
- DevEx: add repro snippet & `x-runtime-variant: stable` header (devex)
- Support: follow up with Acme & Nexa with RCA ETA (tina)
maya: after 30m watch p95/p99 returned to baseline on canary. closing immediate escalation. next: PR review, targeted CI bench, postmortem.
jamal: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4321 — fix targets: batch aging threshold + short-job preemption heuristics.
alex: ✅ keeping thread as runbook reference and linking to incident board.
